Name: Survival Island Beach Edition
Author: Hadi42
TagLine: A reimagining of DaisyNiko's Survival Island map as a replacer for the new 1.5 beach farm!
Description:
I always liked Daisy's[Survival Island](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4561) map, but for my personal preferences, I felt like it would better suit a beach type map. Now that the tilesheets exist to make it possible, I asked Daisy if I could edit her map and she very kindly gave me permission to post this edit!

This map is a little bigger than the original, just out of personal preference. It includes an expanded farm cave, as well as a hidden, OCD-inspired orchard (in case you, like me, have 60000 crop and tree mods), and a smol sandy inlet for the heck of it.

You can select a sprinkler friendly version in the config, or choose to replace a different farm type. If you have[Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098), you can set up your options in-game.

IF YOU ARE USING THE BEACH FARM REPLACER VERSION:

Your pet may spawn in a strange spot and cause a weird tile to appear on the beach. It shouldn't get stuck as of version 1.1, and no other farm types will cause the problem. Once the next version of Adopt n Skin is released, you'll be able to move the pet spawn point to the proper place.

Please keep in mind that all extra assets and the original design of the map and farm cave belong to [DaisyNiko](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61079406) alone, and permissions to use, modify, or otherwise include her work in other mods require _their express permission, **not mine**_. The farm cave and [tilesheets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736) are the same ones included in the original Survival Island to preserve Daisy's aesthetic and prevent issues with the cave not working as intended.

If you like this mod, consider [giving Daisy a tip](https://www.buymeacoffee.com/DaisyNiko)!
